# SDR-MCP Full Reference

SDR (Software Defined Radio) MCP server for RTL-SDR: live spectrum, waterfall, FM audio, station databases, and a GNU Radio demod sidecar.

## Architecture

```
Claude / Cursor ← MCP stdio → SDR MCP Server ← WebSocket → Web dashboard
                                    ↓
                            RTL-SDR (USB) or rtl_tcp
                                    ↓
                            GNU Radio sidecar (Docker)
```

## Ports

| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| Frontend (Vite React) | 11118 |
| MCP HTTP (/mcp) | 11119 |
| GNU Radio demod sidecar | 11223 (compose `gnuradio-demod`, container 8000) |
| Legacy REST bridge (web_api.py, `sdr-mcp serve --http` only) | 10892 (SDR_WEB_API_PORT; NOT served by start.ps1) |

## MCP Tools

### `sdr_device`

Device management. Operations: list, initialize, status, tune, scan, health, mock_mode.

### `sdr_spectrum`

Spectrum analysis. Operations: spectrum, waterfall, websocket.

### `sdr_stations`

Radio station database. Operations: search, by_band, schedule, stats.

### `sdr_online`

Online radio databases. Operations: radio-browser, signal_id.

### `sdr_gnuradio`

GNU Radio demod sidecar. Operations: FM/AM/SSB demod.

### `sdr_agentic_assist`

Multi-step research workflows via MCP sampling.

## Configuration

| Variable | Purpose | Default |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `SDR_MCP_MOCK` | Mock mode (auto/enable/disable) | auto |
| `SDR_WEB_API_PORT` | REST bridge port | 10892 |
| `MCP_TRANSPORT` | Transport mode | stdio |
| `MCP_PORT` | HTTP port override | 11119 |
